title: Unit-to-Plant Stability Shaping of Multi-Electrolyzer ReP2H Plants via Interface Design and Dispatch
summary: Alkaline water electrolysis (AWE) units supplied by insulated gate bipolar transistor rectifiers (IGBT-Rs) may experience oscil-lations caused by coupling between rectifier control and electro-lyzer (ELZ) dynamics. Because this risk varies with unit loading and power allocation, production-oriented dispatch may place a multi-ELZ renewable power-to-hydrogen (ReP2H) plant near or exceed its stability boundary. This paper proposes a stability-oriented framework for control design and plant production dis-patch. A three-port admittance model links the ac port, dc link, and electrolysis stack.…
